title: Camps C2 — the shared Mark paid box
subtitle: Rules v1.001 (one small box for taking a payment everywhere) and v1.104 (the shared box, components/MarkPaidBox.jsx, approved as M3). Today the “$X due” / “Owes $X” tag opens Camps’ own small box: the name, “not paid · $166”, and Mark paid, which always records the camper’s Paying by. After: the same tag opens the shared box: the name and the amount, Paid by Cash / Check / Card preset to the family’s choice with the gray hint, then Mark paid $166 (first focus, so Enter does the usual thing). One tap picks another way. The school still comes from This device (v0.708). The amount is shown, never typed. Sample: Mia Rossi, Thanksgiving Camp, $166 due, chose Cash on the form. Amber = what changes.

One tap on Card. The hint still says what the family chose. Mark paid $166 records card, and Mia’s Paying by becomes Card (Color Belt’s rule, Jeffrey v0.418; logged; Undo payment puts Cash back).

footer: Settled by copying (no question): (a) Picking a different way in the box also changes the camper’s Paying by, logged, and Undo payment puts the old one back — Color Belt’s rule in Jeffrey’s words (v0.418: “If they change how they pay the dashboard should reflect that”). (b) Camps never has the box’s “no choice on record” state: every camper comes from the family form (paper or phone), which always asks Cash / Check / Card. (c) Saving, the “Mia Rossi marked paid · $166 card” toast with Undo, and a failure stay as today. Staff and admins see the same box. Not shown while Hide private details is on (no tags then, v0.722). (d) The database: camp_mark_paid gets a 4th input, the way (blank = Paying by, so today’s app keeps working until the new one is live); one migration with C7’s history reader, number from Main. Question for Jeffrey (one): the hint’s last words after Paying by was changed at the desk (with Change how they’ll pay, or by marking paid a different way). A — always “They chose Cash on the form.” Nothing extra stored. After a desk change it is wrong: staff see “They chose Card on the form.” when the family actually wrote Cash. B — “They chose Card at the desk.” once Paying by was changed at the desk (drawn last in the After column); “on the form” until then. Needs one yes/no saved on the camper in the same migration (set by Change how they’ll pay and Mark paid; Undo payment puts it back). Recommend B: the hint is there so staff trust the preset; a hint that names the wrong place makes them doubt it, and the extra cost is one column in a migration we are writing anyway. Star says “at the desk” only for desk entries (Star has no Change how they’ll pay on paid rows), so this matches Star’s words. Script: mock-c02-markpaid.js mounts the real shared box, filled from the preview’s own camp.
